relations.evidence: Studied Mesopotamian archaeology, then South Asian archaeology at Amsterdam. B.A., M.A. (both in Sumerian and in prehistoric archaeology) 1962 Amsterdam.

relations.subject: Elisabeth Christina Louisa During Caspers
relations.evidence: From 1964 further studies of archaeology in London. Ph.D. 1969 London (under Seton Lloyd).

relations.subject: Elisabeth Christina Louisa During Caspers

relations.object: Kern Institute of Indology, Leiden University
relations.evidence: from 1973 Lecturer at Kern Institute of Indology, Leiden University, until 1986.

relations.subject: Elisabeth Christina Louisa During Caspers
relations.role: Senior Lecturer in Archaeology of South and Southwest Asia
relations.evidence: From 1986 Senior Lecturer in Archaeology of South and Southwest Asia at Department of Archaeology, retired 1995.
